receiver_type: sprite from getSprite() and its property container
returns: Observed property container and metadata values consumed by vanilla moveable naming. Full overload, nullability and runtime contract UNKNOWN.
mutation: Read-only native sprite metadata. No gameplay, synchronization or persistence mutation. Server applications must independently resolve world objects and revalidate permissions/power.

evidence.statement: Vanilla shared moveable code obtains sprite properties and reads CustomName through has/get; no mutation in these observations.
Installed metadata identifies four Desktop Computer facings: appliances_com_01_72/73/74/75; each CustomName is Computer.

notes: Source observation only. Exact CustomName=Computer identifies all four installed desktop facings; other tiles may opt into the same identity metadata. Similar sprite names or translated display labels do not prove a PC. No SP/dedicated invocation or unknown mod identification is claimed. Execution-side observation is from the shared Lua file; native client and dedicated acceptance remain NOT TESTED.
